TC-17/S22.title: Prototype parity (p72_HAIKU) and 'no EHR read or write' review
TC-17/S22.detail: Code half (8b4be94a) passes: both Post-Round tabs copy through useCopyToEmr -> copyTextToClipboard (Capacitor Clipboard / navigator.clipboard / textarea fallback) and both now log the export (useLogExport, NH since b03d53c0 — the 10-14 failure 'NH writes no export record' is fixed); completeEncounter / completeVisit only patch the own chart + a usage event; no FHIR/HL7/Epic/Cerner/EHR code in src or convex. Layout half is a human side-by-side; differences found in code vs p72 for the reviewer: (1) Hospital Note tab renders the Billing Suggestion card BELOW 'Mark Encounter Complete' (p72: billing under the note, the button last; How it works 6 'at the bottom'); NH order matches p72; (2) NH button 'Mark Visit Complete' vs p72 'Mark Encounter Complete'; (3) Hospital task rows keep the urgent flag (retired in p72) and list done tasks struck through instead of p72's 'Pending (n)' list; (4) p72 has no Copy A&P (AC 4 added later).
